notes: IDENTITY, PARENTS, SPOUSE & BIRTHPLACE CORRECTED (research 2026-07-03): this record ("Richard Whetny") is the well-documented Concord, MA immigrant Richard Whitney, confirmed via Geni, WikiTree (Whitney-1692), ourwhitneyfamily.com, and genealogieonline.nl. He was baptized 6 Jan 1623/24 at Isleworth, Middlesex, England — not "Hesworth, London" as recorded, almost certainly a corruption of Isleworth. His parents were John Whitney (1592-1673) and Elinor (Bray) Whitney, immigrants aboard the Elizabeth and Ann in 1635 — not "William John James Whitney" and "Elinor Ellen Arnold" as this tree's parent records (I182587612475, I182587612510) have it. His spouse was Martha Coldam, daughter of Thomas and Joanna Coldam, married 19 Jan 1650/51 at Watertown, MA — not "Mary Flowers Kettle Kendall Kedell" as recorded. Death date (20 Sep 1719, Concord) matches independent sources exactly; he was also a proprietor at Stow, MA by 1680, a fact absent from the tree.
